cases.supported_practice_proposal: Preserve B major and C minor rather than constraining the song to a diatonic G-major palette. Start with deliberate barre changes, then flexible quieter verse picking and fuller chorus attacks. Treat octave lead and acoustic sus4 as separate options.
cases.current_player_note: The current generic arrows are clearly marked practice, but a brief note distinguishing variable verse arpeggio from fuller chorus rhythm would be more useful than presenting one fixed song-wide pattern.
